answer: For a Grade L5 employee, the notice period for resignation is 90 calendar days [S1][S3].

citations.snippet: An Employee in Grades L5 to L8 serves a Notice Period of 90 days.
citations.label: Separation and Exit Policy, p. 5, cl. 5.1

citations.label: Separation and Exit Policy, p. 5, Table 1
